title: Late-year rebound scenario likelihood unavailable

claims.text: The requested likelihood for the late-year rebound sensitivity scenario cannot be reported from the fixed evidence packet: no sensitivity table, scenario parameter entries, or scenario-specific risk cells for a late-year rebound case are present. The packet's coverage note states scenario parameters were not included as scalar parameter evidence, and the assessment is marked non-recomputable, so no scenario probability can be computed or inferred from the available central-case cells.
